notes.title: Saving Friends System
notes.notes:
In this video I have been setting up a system to save your friends held in cages by the evil Broctopus and his bootlickers! Your friends will be hidden throughout the different worlds in the game, however these ones are just in the starting Hub level. 

You can find more Devlog videos on my Youtube channel as well. 

[previewyoutube=mMg6DVNwrqI;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: World Entrances in the Hub
notes.notes:
Hello! 

First post here on Gillbert: Guardian of the Grotto. I'll be updating the news here with progress on the game frequently. Today I have been working on the World entrances in the Hub! 

[previewyoutube=6JYth19Ph7A;full][/previewyoutube]

There will be 6 worlds in total + the end boss world. Here's a rundown:

[b]World 1[/b]
Ruined Ruins

[b]World 2[/b]
Dusty Desert

[b]World 3[/b]
Gem Caves

[b]World4[/b]
Freeze the Day

[b]World 5[/b]
Watered Down

[b]World 6[/b]
Trout Town

There is lots more to come, stay tuned!
